body.x: MH, a Taiwanese company, introduced its smart home made with IoT at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Its IoT technology is the hand movement recognition technology that can turn off the lights and open and close the curtains. All the items in the room that can be controlled are connected in IoT. It also displayed a technology to show the 3D image of the building printed on the business card, along with a VR image display technology like "Pokemon Go".

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
